name: kea-dhcp-ui
description: Modern Web UI for Kea DHCP Server Management

scripts.dev:server: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SHARED,TSC,SRV" -c "yellow,blue,green" "pnpm --filter @kea/shared run build:watch" "pnpm --filter @kea/server run build:watch" "node --watch apps/server/dist/index.js"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @kea/shared run build && pnpm --filter @kea/server run build && pnpm --filter @kea/client run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @kea/shared run typecheck && pnpm --filter @kea/server run build && pnpm --filter @kea/client run build
